cells.gaps: No regulation issued under the Act and no decision, sanction or count under it has been found, so stage 4 is not met. The Commissioner is designated by the Act but no source says it has begun acting under it.
cells.note: The Act is promulgated and printed (9 and 23 March 2026, signed 19 August 2026) with a one-year compliance period running (s.41), which places stage 3; stage 4 needs a dated application fact. LBR-001 (13 September 2026) refers to responsibilities under the Act but does not state it is in force, so standing is read as transition; either value gives stage 3.
